reason: I already run cards on Square on my iPad and it works, so a new company I never heard of has to earn my Saturdays. I'm not putting my whole salon's money on a new app and a $299 reader without seeing it work in a salon I know.
objection: What happens when the internet goes down on a busy Saturday, and who do I call when it breaks? A small new company could be gone in a year and I'd be stuck with a reader and my client list inside it.
would_change_my_mind: Another salon owner I know and trust, running it for months, shows me it keeps taking cards when the Wi-Fi is down, and they let me try it free next to Square for a month without switching.
